question.text: Which Z-score does parametric VaR use for 99% confidence?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** One-tailed Z-scores: 90% = 1.282, 95% = 1.645, 99% = 2.33. For VaR (one-tail, left), use 2.33 at 99%. **The Trap:** 1.96 is two-tailed 95% (confidence interval), not one-tailed VaR. 1.645 is 95% VaR. **Cross-Exam Context:** Central to XXI-B; no other NISM exam tests VaR at this depth. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Always clarify one-tail vs two-tail when reading academic vs industry VaR definitions.
